-   [Contact](#)

# Download the Kindle Fire APK

[](javascript:window.print() "Print this article")

If you are unable to locate or download the OVERDRIVE or OVERDRIVE: Fast & Furious Edition (Available September 2017) from within the Amazon Appstore, this means that your Amazon Kindle device is known to not support OVERDRIVE and will not support OVERDRIVE: Fast & Furious Edition apps. Either it does not meet a specific requirement, or we’ve have specifically disabled it because there were problems that we could not fix or workaround. 

------------------------------------------------------------------------

For specifics about supported Amazon Kindle Devices please refer to this article:

**[OVERDRIVE / OVERDRIVE: Fast & Furious Edition Compatible Devices](//support.digitaldreamlabs.com/article/255-compatible-devices-overdrive-fast-furious-edition)**

------------------------------------------------------------------------

For more details about device compatibility, for some suggestions on how to potentially use your device, and for a link to an .apk file, please refer to this article:

**[Anki OVERDRIVE: Details about Device Compatibility](//support.digitaldreamlabs.com/article/253-compatible-devices-further-information)**

------------------------------------------------------------------------

For an .apk file that might install and work on your unsupported device, please read this article:

**[Anki OVERDRIVE: APK some for unsupported devices](//support.digitaldreamlabs.com/article/244-download-the-android-apk)**
